حِمْيَةٌ : see the next preceding paragraph. ＝
-A2- Also an inf. n. of حَمَى المَكَانَ [q. v.]: (Msb:) and of حَمَيْتُ المَرِيضَ [q. v.]. (S, Msb.) ＝
-A3- Also The practising abstinence; (PS in art. ازم;) [especially the abstaining from things injurious in a case of sickness;] the abstaining, or desisting, from eating. (TA in that art.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
